capabilities: Renders blank lines between paragraphs as larger gaps
Adjusts list and task indentation like a rich-text editor
Adds controls above tables and supports HTML tables
Previews inline math and styles display math blocks
Manages content themes with search, grouping and import/export
extras: Development is primarily on Windows; macOS, Linux and mobile support is unverified, and performance may degrade on long documents. A showcase vault with the plugin preinstalled is offered in releases.
intentEvidence: Improve rendering in each view, especially Source mode, along with copying and pasting.
motivation: The author loved Typora's distraction-free experience and Obsidian's wiki links, and wanted to build an "Obsidian with Typora inside."
problem: Obsidian's default rendering gives tight paragraph spacing and less rich-text-like handling of lists, tables, quotes and math than Typora does.

relations.evidence: I love Typora's distraction-free experience and Obsidian's wiki links, so I wanted to build an "Obsidian with Typora inside."

summary: Typora-style rendering plugin that enlarges paragraph gaps, adjusts list indentation, adds table controls, previews math and styles code blocks.
